name: design
description: Design and UX research skills for Claude, each backed by a cited reference library.

plugins.name: ux-research
plugins.description: Five UX research skills: scope a brief, write a discussion guide, plan a usability test, draft or audit a survey, and run desk research.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Four review skills: a flow for usability, a screen for visual craft, its copy for clarity, or all three at once with the duplicates removed.

plugins.name: design-strategy
plugins.description: Two strategy skills: analyse which themes a page uses to solve its problem, then narrow them to the levers you can dial and the psychology behind each.

plugins.name: project-brief
plugins.description: Defines why a project is being done before any design or code, then derives the stage plan from that.
